title: Chassidic Leaders Meet
body: Senior chassidic rebbes convened in Yerushalayim to discuss the proposed draft law, amid heightened tension within the governing coalition.

title: Amar'e Meets with Rav Yosef
body: Former NBA star Amar'e Stoudemire met with Rav Dovid Yosef, Israel's Chief Rabbi, in Miami. Rav Yosef offered Stoudemire a bracha, encouraging him to continue on his spiritual path as a public example of Orthodox Judaism.
